thread:
darren: Heads-up — MeridianPay has a phased load test next Tue 09:00 PT (team asked for Redwood-side watch). Plan: ramp to 2k rps over 30m, hold 15m, then ramp down. Main risks: cache coldstart, token quota surges, and fallback chain correctness. Please post coverage windows and any preflight checks you want done.

leah: I can cover 08:30-12:30 PT. Will do the initial smoke and stay for first 90m of ramp. @anna can you confirm fallback model chain and if there's a canary route to limit blast radius? :thumbsup:

anna: Confirmed fallback order: primary -> redwood-neo-1, fallback -> redwood-neo-1-qa, cpu-safemode -> redwood-cpu-v1. Canary route exists: meridian-pay:canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%). Rollout policy already attached to their deployment. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/meridianpay-preflight (internal).

oncall-bot: shift assigned: leah (08:30-12:30 PT) — Reminder: run preflight checklist before 08:45.

mike: I'll watch GPU util, request queue length, and billing throttles from 08:30-13:00. If GPU util > 85% or p95 latency > 200ms, I'll trigger the scale-up play and notify infra.

darren: Two small preflight requests: (1) pre-warm KV caches for typical prompt prefixes, (2) run a token-rate-sim for expected 10k tokens/s burst to validate quota and rate limiter. Example cache-warm curl (internal):

```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/warm" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"customer":"meridianpay","prefixes":["invoice","payment_intent","reconcile"]}'
```

leah: I'll kick off the warm and the smoke at 08:35. For the token rate sim, who's got the sim script? @mike?

mike: I have the sim script and will run it at 08:45 in a gated env first. I will share the one-liner in ops channel 15m before.

anna: Ops note — ensure fallback routing policy has the right model-compatibility matrix; last time we had an incompatible quantization profile on the qa model and had to revert. I added a compatibility guard in rollout config just now.

darren: Good catch. Also, MeridianPay's contract has a 99.9% latency SLA on peak windows — if we see >0.1% error or latency breach, alert product and sales immediately (escalation list in runbook).

leah: Quick logistics Q: who will own on-call handoff at 12:30 when I'm off? I can hand to @darren if you're free.

darren: I can pick up 12:30-16:00 PT. If anything high-severity pops, I'll coordinate with infra and notify customer.

leah: Perfect. I'll post a short summary and pin it in the channel once the warm completes. :white_check_mark:

mike: I'll post the sim results + dashboards link as soon as the gated sim finishes.

anna: One last reminder — add the fallback debug flag to the deployment so we can toggle verbose KV logging if needed: set header X-RW-Debug: fallback-trace.

darren: Summary pinned: MeridianPay load test Tue 09:00 PT, leah 08:30-12:30, darren 12:30-16:00. Preflight: KV warm + token-rate sim + canary route in place. Alerts: GPU util >85%, p95 >200ms, errors >0.1% -> escalate. Thanks team :rocket:
